findings.fix: Move these four declarations into a section with `variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [LieRing.IsNilpotent L]` and the two module instances; keep only `genWeightSpaceProdEquiv`/`finrank_genWeightSpace_prod`/`formalCharacter_prod` over the field.

findings.evidence: code/TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Integrality.lean:84-88 (section vars: `Field K`, `CharZero K`, `IsKilling K L`, `FiniteDimensional K L`, `H.IsCartanSubalgebra`, `IsTriangularizable K H L` — no `IsAlgClosed`) and :198 `isIntegralWeight_of_weight`; mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Basic.lean:757 `instIsTriangularizableOfIsAlgClosed` is the only route `IsAlgClosed` serves here.
findings.fix: State it as `omit [IsAlgClosed K] in theorem isIntegralWeight_of_formalCharacter_coeff_ne_zero [IsTriangularizable K H L] {χ : Dual K H} ...`, matching the hypothesis set of `Integrality.lean`.
findings.issue: `isIntegralWeight_of_formalCharacter_coeff_ne_zero` inherits `[IsAlgClosed K]` from the section, but algebraic closedness is used only to synthesize `IsTriangularizable K H L`; the theorem it consumes, `isIntegralWeight_of_weight`, is deliberately stated with `[IsTriangularizable K H L]` and no `IsAlgClosed`, and `LinearWeights K H M` comes from `CharZero` alone.

summary: The character definition and its API sit at the right level, but the new product-of-modules weight API is confined to a base field although every ingredient is CommRing-level (Mathlib convention), and the integrality corollary carries `IsAlgClosed K` where its own input only needs `IsTriangularizable K H L`.
